package.description: Vovsoft SVG Converter is an offline batch tool to vectorize images to SVG or rasterize vectors to PNG, JPEG, and PDF securely with no upload limits.

en-US.description: Vovsoft SVG Converter is an offline batch tool to vectorize images to SVG or rasterize vectors to PNG, JPEG, and PDF securely with no upload limits.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft SVG Converter is a comprehensive desktop utility designed for seamlessly transforming images between raster and vector formats.

The software allows you to convert your files in both directions:
* Image to SVG (Vectorize): Easily convert raster images (like JPEGs or PNGs) into infinitely scalable vectors. You can load multiple images and customize advanced vectorization settings—such as presets, clustering, and hierarchical modes—to generate high-quality SVG files from photos or pixelated logos.
* SVG to Image (Rasterize): Need to batch convert SVG to PNG, WEBP, JPEG, BMP, HTML, or PDF? The rasterization feature handles bulk conversions effortlessly. It preserves background transparency where applicable and allows for lossless scaling by entering any specific pixel width and height. You can even apply a "Convert to grayscale" filter to instantly create black and white pictures.

Batch Image Processing: The application is built for mass conversion. Easily process as many files as you want through a user-friendly interface by simply selecting your input files in bulk and letting the tool do the heavy lifting.

Overlay Image & Watermarking: Place a transparent PNG image directly over your converted results. This overlay feature makes it incredibly easy to bulk-add watermarks, logos, or additional visual elements to your exported graphics.

100% Offline & Secure: While many online SVG converter websites can convert images, they often come with strict upload limitations and privacy concerns. This program operates completely offline on your laptop or desktop computer. You retain total control of your private data, ensuring no image files are ever sent over the internet.

Trial limitations: The free trial cannot convert SVG files, does not permit commercial use, and includes nag screens and advertisements. Purchasing a license removes these limitations.

Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) is an XML-based file extension containing scalable images. Utilizing a lossless data compression algorithm, it supports vector graphics, raster images, and text. Because it is mathematically defined rather than pixel-based, this format can be infinitely scaled without losing quality and can be edited using both dedicated drawing software and text editors.

Key Features:
* PNG to SVG
* JPG to SVG
* JPEG to SVG
* WEBP to SVG
* TIF to SVG
* TIFF to SVG
* SVG to PNG
* SVG to WEBP
* SVG to HTML
* SVG to JPG
* SVG to BMP
* SVG to PDF
